## IP, Licensing, and Release Checklist

- [ ] The code is original or authorized for contribution.
- [ ] The change contains no secrets.
- [ ] The change contains no customer data.
- [ ] New dependencies were reviewed for license and supply-chain risk.
- [ ] New assets have documented provenance.
- [ ] The change does not alter the product license posture.
- [ ] The change does not make a private package public.
- [ ] Third-party notices were updated when applicable.
- [ ] SBOM and license inventory were updated when dependencies changed.
- [ ] AI-assisted changes were reviewed by a responsible human contributor.
- [ ] Tests and compliance checks pass or documented exceptions are attached.
